title: Concept: Bank account number served together with a balance
description: Account number plus balance is the pair fraud teams use to pass identity checks and to target high-value accounts; a single leaked payload can expose thousands of them.
applicability: Account summary APIs, mobile-app home screens and open-banking aggregation endpoints.
risk: A leaked payload hands an attacker a list of live account numbers sorted by value, ready for social engineering or account takeover attempts.
